mapper.select: SELECT feedback_status AS status, COUNT(*) AS total FROM review_issue WHERE task_id = #{taskId} GROUP BY feedback_status
SELECT severity AS status, COUNT(*) AS total FROM review_issue WHERE task_id = #{taskId} GROUP BY severity

SELECT id AS issue_id, title AS title, category AS category, severity AS severity, confidence AS confidence, start_line AS start_line, end_line AS end_line, feedback_status AS feedback_status FROM review_issue WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND file_id = #{fileId} ORDER BY severity DESC, id ASC

SELECT i.id AS issue_id, i.title AS title, i.category AS category, i.severity AS severity, i.confidence AS confidence, f.file_path AS file_path, i.start_line AS start_line, i.end_line AS end_line, i.trigger_condition AS trigger_condition, i.impact AS impact, i.evidence AS evidence, i.suggestion AS suggestion, i.feedback_status AS feedback_status, i.feedback_remark AS feedback_remark FROM review_issue i LEFT JOIN task_file f ON f.id = i.file_id AND f.task_id = i.task_id WHERE i.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY i.severity DESC, i.id ASC
